snippet.title: Cyber Seekers: Conquest - Official Gameplay Trailer [ Indie-Credible Showcase 2026 ]
snippet.description:
Play as a bot for hire and complete contracts in a Third-Person traversal shooter with Rogue Lite mechanics. Run on walls and use your grapple gun to traverse and hunt down rogue bots who have conquered a city.

Official Steampage:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2930410/Cyber_Seekers_Conquest/

This trailer is part of the Indie-Credible - Indie Game Showcase 2026:
